tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. Neutral with a slight green bias.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: Panels, cards, drawers' inner surfaces, inputs on surface.

tokens.name: sunken
tokens.usage: Board columns, segmented-control track, row hover, message blocks.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on surface, raised and sunken.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, table headers, metadata. Passes 4.5:1 on surface and raised.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines, panel borders, table rules, input borders.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Primary action fill, active nav, progress bars, rent-received bars. Text on it uses brand-ink.

tokens.name: brand-ink
tokens.usage: Labels and icons on a brand fill.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Active nav item and 'Ready to move in' pills, with ink text.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Saffron. Fills only: cost bars, the logo door, highlights. Never body text in light theme (3.4:1).

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Saffron as text, on accent-soft or raised (the 'Sample data' tag).

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted background behind accent-ink text.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Paid, Valid, Resolved, Active. Text on ok-soft.

tokens.name: ok-soft
tokens.usage: Background of success pills.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Due soon, part paid, on notice, High priority. Text on warn-soft.

tokens.name: warn-soft
tokens.usage: Background of warning pills and caution notes.

tokens.name: bad
tokens.usage: Overdue, expired, emergency, arrears figures. Text on bad-soft or raised.

tokens.name: bad-soft
tokens.usage: Background of critical pills and nav count badges.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Due, Normal priority, in-progress stages. Text on info-soft.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Background of info pills and guidance notes.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links. Alias of brand.

groups.name: Headings
groups.note: Sora from Google Fonts, weights 500–700. Headings only.

groups.name: Figures
groups.note: IBM Plex Mono with tabular numerals for money, counts and references.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap inside pills and between nav items.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons in a row.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card padding, stat grid gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding, grid gap, minimum phone gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections, desktop gutter.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Large separations.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Country tags (UK / IN).

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, board cards, notes.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Panels, stat tiles, board columns, modals.

tokens.name: shadow-1
tokens.usage: Selected segmented button and the side drawer only.
